You hand Sayn your write-up, "A Study of the Bonesky Family," and he tells you how the titles "Recas" and "Icho" came to be. Long ago, so the story goes, the Bonesky and Emberpup families lived side by side, fetching water together and even holding water-fetching contests. One Recas-Icho duo set a record that has never been broken. After upheavals in the land drove the two families apart, those names gradually became titles borne by the strongest Glynsera and the strongest Scorchhowl.
